comment: Another price bump and still no lossless tier? I already pay Tidal for the hi-fi stuff and keep Spotify just for Connect and Discover Weekly. Not cancelling yet but this makes the second sub harder to justify.

Price going up for an app that still won't show my hearts on album track lists. The ads are fine on free, it's the liked songs stuff that bugs me. Apple Music keeps looking better every time I open this thing.
Already gone over the music tab redesign so the price doesn't even register for me. Bring back the album tiles and I'd think about coming back, until then it's a no.
A dollar more for Spotify is fine honestly, radio and Discover Weekly still beat everything else I've tried. I'm just still annoyed album radio is gone.
Still worth every penny. A dollar more is nothing for no ads, offline and unlimited skips every day. The free tier treatment is still the annoying part for me.
They raise the price and I still can't get a true random shuffle. The service is great otherwise, but the shuffle thing keeps pushing me to look at Apple Music.
Nickel and dime. They took the heart button out of playlists and now want more money on top. Money grubbing, honestly, I'd pay for the heart button back but not like this.
Doesn't touch me, I'm still on the old build so I never see the price stuff anyway. I'll cancel the day they force the new layout on me though.
Price goes up and the UI keeps burying my library and shoving podcasts at me. YouTube Music is a great deal and I'm half out the door already.
The price bump is annoying but Premium is still worth it to me. Until they revert the home screen I'm not paying more for a TikTok feed, so I'll cancel if it stays like this.
Spotify raises prices while artists get fractions of a cent per stream. That's greed, and I already moved to Apple Music over artist pay so this just confirms it.
I'm on the free tier so this doesn't affect me directly. If Premium gets pricier though, I'm even less likely to ever pay for it since ads keep getting more frequent.
Still a bang-for-the-buck deal for how much I use it every day. Hope they don't keep taking perks away and then raising prices though.
Student price going up a dollar, bummed. It's still a great deal with Hulu included, but I'm watching the perks closely after the Showtime thing.
320 is still good enough for AirPods and the car, so a dollar more doesn't change my mind. No lossless is still the real gap, and I'm not paying Tidal's higher tiers either.
Music is absurdly cheap for what you get, but this extra money goes to Spotify and the artists still get almost nothing per stream. Show me a better payout and I'd happily pay more.
Raising the price with no lossless or Spatial Audio is a tough sell. Apple Music is the better deal right now, so I'm probably going back over there.
Not thrilled, but Premium is still cheap for the library and Discover Weekly. I'll keep paying while I complain about the repeat recommendations and the new UI.
A month still costs less than an hour of my pay and I'd never give up the ad-free listening. The only thing I'd fix is the cancel flow that keeps asking me to renew.
Another price hike for an app that breaks after every update. I cancelled before over a bug that never got fixed, so I'm not sure what they're spending it on.
I already cancelled and the renewal pop-up still shows up every time I open the app. A price increase doesn't even matter to me, I just want the thing to stop nagging me.

Worth it for the daily music but the home screen is full of podcasts and the music filter is a pain. I can live with the price, but if the app stays unusable I'm out, and I was already looking at Deezer.
Honestly still worth it for me. Collaborative playlists, Connect and no ads are hard to beat, and lossless would be nice but it's not a dealbreaker.
Family plan is still pretty cheap per person when you split it, so the bump is fine. My only worry is the plan switching mess and the random charges that come with it.
Still worth it to me, I've been paying since 2018 and I'm not leaving over a dollar. I am bummed they keep removing features though, like the stuff I actually set up.
Paying more for ad-free music is fine but podcast ads still play for Premium users. That's a dollar more for nothing, and the podcast push on my home screen is still there.
Price hike while they keep messing with playlists and the enhance feature. I already cancelled Premium once over feature changes, and I'm not paying more for this.
I'll pay the extra dollar, Premium is still the best value I get from any subscription. The free tier is way too restricted to be worth using.
